descriptions.M2_prs: D-PRISM multi-ancestry PRS (5 components), logistic regression
descriptions.M3_additive: PRS + 5 mechanism scores + BMI, logistic regression (best additive model)
descriptions.M4_rf: Random forest on additive features + 67 mechanism SNPs
descriptions.M5_svm: RBF support vector machine on the same inputs
descriptions.M7_xgb_pairs: XGBoost + explicit products of the K selected pairs (classical interaction model)
descriptions.H_twin: Classical twin encoder with its own linear head
descriptions.H_noent: VQC without entanglement, own linear head
descriptions.M11_qsvc: Quantum fidelity-kernel SVC on the top circuit
descriptions.M12_stack: QGenomix stack: logistic regression on M3, M10, M11 out-of-fold scores
